## Locathah Guard (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
Locathah fighter 3  
N Medium humanoid (aquatic)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +8  

**Defense**

 **AC** 23, touch 16, flat-footed 19 (+1 dodge, +7 armor, +3 Dex, +2 natural)  
**hp** 59 (2d8+3d10+13)  
**Fort** +8, **Ref** +5, **Will** +4  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 10 ft., swim 60 ft.  
**Melee** longspear +7 (1d8+3/×3)  
**Ranged** light crossbow +8 (1d8/19–20)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 14, **Dex** 16, **Con** 14, **Int** 12, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 19  
**Feats** Combat Reflexes, Furious Focus, Weapon Focus (longspear), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Craft (any one) +6, Escape Artist +5, Perception +8, Survival +9, Swim +10; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Swim  
**Languages** Aquan, Common  
**SQ** amphibious  
**Combat Gear** oil of magic weapon, potion of cure moderate wounds, potion of slipstream; **Other Gear** +1 breastplate, masterwork longspear, masterwork light crossbow (20 bolts), daggers (2)
